notes: Primary keccak256-metadata case: zksolc <=1.5.12 (here 1.5.7) appends a bare keccak256 metadata hash, not CBOR. Recompiled metadata differs from on-chain so runtime is only a PARTIAL match; and because the EraVM versioned bytecode hash is all-or-nothing, a partial runtime cannot creation-match (creationMatch stays null even though the contract is a direct deploy). Also exercises the pre-1.5.8 path where zksolc accepts an upstream (non-fork) solc backend.
